question: Should this protected, multi-surface Control UI refactor proceed after a maintainer verifies the shared helper contracts and accepts real after-fix UI proof?
rationale: The `maintainer` label requires explicit human handling, and the current review could not complete the repository-level caller and history audit needed to independently validate a behavior-neutral refactor.

options.title: Complete focused maintainer review
options.body: Verify the shared helper contracts and representative callers, then accept redacted Control UI runtime proof before merging.

options.title: Split by behavior boundary
options.body: Ask for smaller follow-up PRs if the combined refactor prevents a confident review of storage, keyboard, and rendering behavior.

recommendation.title: Complete focused maintainer review
recommendation.body: Verify the shared helper contracts and representative callers, then accept redacted Control UI runtime proof before merging.

likelyOwner.reason: The provided context identifies steipete as the author of every commit in the proposed UI refactor stack.
